leave.body: Leaving keeps your character sheet. Joining a different chronicle later needs approval; you can rejoin this one while it stays open.
leave.title: Leave this chronicle?

delete.body: Deleting removes every room, character, message and roll of this chronicle. This cannot be undone.
delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.typeName: Type the chronicle’s name, {{name}}, to confirm

members.pcFailed: Could not set the playing character
members.title: Members
members.pcHint: Players switch characters in this chronicle only with Storyteller approval.
members.forbidden: Only the Storyteller or staff can add members.
members.pcNone: This player has no character in this chronicle yet.

field.name: Name
field.descriptionHint: The Storyteller AI reads this as the chronicle’s world. You can edit it later.
field.systemV5Hint: V5 currently supports Vampire: The Masquerade.

world.title: World & setting
world.warning: The AI Storyteller reads this as the world. Changing it changes world generation, NPC behaviour and how characters are treated.

rooms.title: Locations
rooms.open: Open to players (unchecked = closed, scene paused)
rooms.oocAlwaysOpen: The OOC lobby cannot be closed.
rooms.deleteBody: All messages in this room are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
rooms.forbidden: Only the Storyteller of this chronicle or an admin can change its locations.
rooms.name: Name
rooms.descriptionHint: Shown under the room name; the AI Storyteller reads it too.

edition.classicHint: d10 vs target number, 1s cancel, botches
edition.locked: The edition is locked once the chronicle is created.

creation.title: Character creation rules
creation.intro: What the V5 forge offers new characters in this chronicle. Characters already made are not changed.
creation.flawsMax: Most Flaw dots a player may take (empty = no limit)
creation.fledgling: Offer just-Embraced fledglings the Humanity 8 start
creation.houseRules: House rules (shown at the top of the forge)
creation.flawsHint: Ancillae take 4 Flaw dots, so a limit under 4 needs ancillae left out.
creation.savedCap: Advantage dots a player may leave unspent and save for later (0–20)
creation.savedSpecialty: Players may save the free specialty of their choice
creation.stModeAiHint: Spends that follow the rules are approved at once by a fixed rule check (not the language model) and logged under Approvals, where you can reverse any of them. House rules always wait for you.
creation.stModeHumanHint: Every spend waits for you under Approvals.
creation.stModeSuggest: You play a character in this chronicle yourself. With the AI Storyteller, the rule check approves your own spends instead of you.

approvals.approved: Approved and added to the sheet.
approvals.reversed: Reversed: the sheet is as it was before.
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.introAi: AI Storyteller mode: spends of saved points that follow the rules are approved at once by the rule check and listed here; you can reverse them. House rules wait for you.
approvals.intro: Players spend the points they saved at creation here; nothing changes on a sheet until you approve.
approvals.nowHouseRule: The sheet changed since the player asked: this spend breaks the rules now.
approvals.confirmNeeded: This spend breaks the rules now: check the problems and confirm.
